maya: Heads-up — product asked for a new runtime dashboard that combines routing policy hit-rates, per-route latency p95, and per-model token throughput. Need input on exporters + aggregation window + retention & a minimal backfill plan. Who can own the telemetry side?
kevin: I can sketch exporters. Quick Q: do we want per-request routing tags (region, tier, route_id) included? that increases cardinality a lot.
sasha: @kevin yes we need route_id and region. tier is optional for first pass. we can roll tier into aggregation later. main ask from console is filter by route_id in UI.
kevin: ok. will add labels: route_id, region. will avoid user_id and model_input_hash.
ryan: FYI runtime will emit two new counters: routing_policy_matches_total (label: policy, route_id, region) and tokens_emitted_total (label: model, route_id). also will add request_latency_seconds histogram (le/0.01,0.05,0.1,0.5,1,2,5).
anika: for dashboards we prefer 1h aggregation for throughput charts and 5m for latency heatmaps. retention: product asks 90 days for perf metrics, 365 for audit-level routing logs. is that realistic for exporters?
kevin: Prometheus long-term storage costs blow up with 365 days at high cardinality. proposal: 90d for metrics at 1h rollup, 30d at 5m raw. Keep 365d only for low-cardinality audit logs exported to GCS (not TSDB).
maya: sounds reasonable. need a concrete backfill approach — product wants historical 6 weeks of p95 for rollout comparison. do we have archived raw scrapes?
ryan: we keep raw scrapes for 14 days in local TSDB. we do have shard-level WALs older but cold and not trivially queryable. Backfill options: (A) re-run aggregation from cold WALs (heavy, ops time); (B) approximate using sampled traces + existing logs; (C) say 14d only and make 6w a stretch goal.
sasha: ops prefers (A) if we can schedule during a low-traffic weekend; need ~36h maintenance window for cluster rebuild.
kevin: alternative hybrid: backfill 6 weeks for p95 at 1h resolution by replaying only routing_policy_matches and tokens_emitted counters (smaller), skip full histogram backfill — we'd compute p95 from sampled request latencies if histograms missing (approx).
anika: UI note: if p95 is approximated we should surface a small badge: "estimated". product OK with that.
maya: action items: @kevin prepare exporter config PR with labels + retention hints; @ryan estimate ops time and whether WAL replay script exists; @sasha coordinate maintenance window if needed; @anika prepare dashboard wire with estimated vs exact indicators. Please post single-line updates here when done.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: prometheus-exporter:v2.3 -> staging at 2025-10-18T03:00:00Z (rollout id: r-8841)
kevin: I'm going to open the exporter PR this afternoon. config snippet below:
```
job_name: runtime_metrics
scrape_interval: 15s
metrics_path: /metrics
static_configs:
  - targets: ['runtime-frontend:9100']
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_route]
    target_label: route_id
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_node_label_region]
    target_label: region
# retention guidance: raw_5m: 30d, rollup_1h: 90d, audit_gcs: 365d
```
ryan: quick note on aggregation jobs: prefer nightly windowed job that computes 1h rollups from 5m bins. will add a MapReduce-like job that reads from TSDB blocks; estimate 4h runtime for prod cluster.
sasha: I'll scope maintenance window and ping infra calendar.
anika: starting dashboard mock in figma, will mark p95 as estimated if necessary.
maya: thanks all. I'll consolidate decisions and open the coordination RFC. will tag these tasks in the RFC and link back here.
kevin: update — exporter PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/kevin/runtime-exporter/+/123 (contains label and retention docs)
ryan: ops estimate posted in GH issue #452: ~6h for rollup job + 36h if full TSDB rebuild. link in RFC.
maya: closing loop: product agreed to the hybrid backfill. next sync Thurs 11am to validate dashboards.
kevin: ack.
